$comment: Sighter's CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6; the field list is in .gitea/actions/README.md): a Linux leg of ci.yml for the pure core (crates/sighter-core): fmt, clippy, nextest, doc tests and deny. The core has no OS-specific code yet, so there are no Windows or macOS legs; the capture and input adapters add them. There is no UI, installer or release yet.
